purpose: Audit whole SLI dashboard, distinguish automatically refreshed data, candidate-only news, archival sources and manually curated reference tables; no fabricated auto-update completeness.
schedule: 4 checks per day, approximately 07:07, 13:07, 19:07, 01:07 WIB (GitHub Actions delays possible)

model.automated_numeric: Machine-readable numerical source updates run on schedule and pass schema checks; historical observation is not necessarily current
model.automated_discovery: Automated source/news/publisher checks that generate review candidates; do not equate news with verified changes
model.computed_from_sources: Automatically recalculated assessment from already available monitored observations; cannot establish causality
model.curated_snapshot: Published/extracted reference data; new editions require verified re-ingestion or manual review
model.static_reference: Historical atlas/map/source data that changes only on publication/source replacement
model.status_unknown: No deterministic writer discovered; never claim automatic refresh

data/ai-intelligence.json.note: Project MW, operator, financing, GPU fleet and COD require sourced project-specific confirmations. AI news workflow is discovery-only.

data/ai-investment-events.json.note: Milestone ledger only changes after evidence verification; not automatically inferred from announcements.

data/ai-risk-evidence.json.note: Diligence score reflects evidence completeness, never implied changes in financial or legal risks.

data/sli-macro-indonesia-2026.json.note: BPS/BI/Kemenkeu 2026 press-release snapshot; NOT yet an automated current monthly/quarterly feed. WDI series updates separately.

data/sli-macro-worldbank-history.json.note: World Bank WDI annual history synced weekly; API omissions retained as missing and never interpolated.

data/commodity-market-prices.json.note: Automatic quotes/price observations; verify actual quote date, publisher and fallback fields.

data/regulatory-monitor.json.note: Document changes and policy news are review candidates; the legally effective law graph remains curated.

data/sli-policy-regulatory-graph-2026.js.note: Changes to in-force/amended/repealed status require official primary legal document, not news headline.

data/sli-public-policy-evaluation-2026.j.note: Ex-ante/process/ex-post assessments need quantitative outcomes, attribution design and researcher review.

data/investment-projects.json.note: Announced financing and capacity must not be automatically equated with actual commissioned projects.

data/energy-events.json.note: Events are discovered from public announcements; validate cancellations and actual dates.

data/energy-actors-status.json.note: Leadership watch should not auto-replace current officials without unambiguous legal appointment.

data/sector-leadership-watch.json.note: Actor source checks are not appointment proof.

data/investment-forbes-top20.json.note: Forbes rank updates require publication-specific source and date; never invent wealth estimates.

data/energy-fundamentals.json.note: Historical statistics are edition-specific; new ESDM/PLN publications require digitization.

data/heesi-2025-integrated.json.note: HEESI 2025 archived source values do not change when a later edition appears.

data/pln-ruptl-uploaded-excerpt-2025-203.note: Only initial 100-page RUPTL excerpt; new annex and revisions require document validation.

data/commodity-trade-flows.json.note: Trade partner/commodity Sankey currently represents a particular statistical vintage; requires verified periodic BPS/UN Comtrade ingestion.

data/daily-energy-assessment.json.note: Rule-based daily assessment from observed data, not direct proof of changes in energy security.

readiness_rules.failure_alert: Workflow latest conclusion != success, stale scheduled observations, missing official source, or missing freshness metadata appears in dashboard.
readiness_rules.legacy_static_coverage: Curated static report values remain valid for their stated reference years but do not update until new source editions are verified and ingested.
readiness_rules.review_queue: Candidate only for legal changes, appointments, project implementation, forecasts, maps and new PDF/report digitization.
readiness_rules.live_site_delivery: Prefer raw public repository JSON with local Pages fallback; website code still requires GitHub Pages deployments.
readiness_rules.operational_success: A successful workflow run confirms execution, not source completeness or semantic validity.
